column1: # 1000 Genomes phase 3, GRCh38, split-by-chromosome, rsID-annotated (dbSNP156), KING-corrected.
# pgen.zst = genotypes; _rs.pvar.zst = variant table WITH rsIDs; hg38_corrected.psam = shared sample file.
# WARNING: pgen and pvar must come from the SAME cog-genomics release generation, else plink2 rejects
#   the pair ('PgfiInitPhase1 raw_variant_ct mismatch'). The pgen URLs for chr {1,2,5,6,7,8,9,11,16,19}
#   were corrected 2026-07 to match the _rs pvar generation. The OTHER 12 pgen URLs are still the older
#   generation and MAY mismatch — download_data.sh now runs `plink2 --validate` per chr and fails loudly
#   if so; replace the offending pgen URL with the current cog-genomics link before a whole-genome run.
